abstract: Gastric adenocarcinoma with yolk sac tumor (YST) differentiation has rarely been reported. We report a case of primary gastric adenocarcinoma with yolk sac tumor differentiation and liver metastases of the YST component in a 50-years-old patient. This was suspected due to high serum level of alpha fetoprotein in the presence of a gastric fundal tumor. Gastric carcinoma with yolk sac tumor component is a rare entity with a poor prognostic outcome.
abstract_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍(YST)分化を伴う胃腺癌はまれにしか報告されていない。本稿では、50歳患者の胃底部腫瘍に伴い血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値が高値を示し、原発性の卵黄嚢腫瘍分化を伴う胃腺癌と、YST成分の肝転移を認めた症例を報告する。胃癌にYST成分を伴う病変は稀な病態であり、予後不良である。
